spans.s: erita, ppp. (= Pali id., to ereti; Skt. īrita, to īrayati, which takes the preverb ā only in the Veda, and no erita, ppp., seems recorded even there), stirred, moved (by wind), or (of musical instruments) struck: LV 〔194.10〕 (vs) vṛkṣā māruta-eritā (cf. Skt. vāyv-īrita, Mbh., BR); so Lefm., most mss. -īr˚; Mv 〔iii.367.12, 17〕 (vs) (gandho …) upavāyati erito mārutena; Divy 〔251.3〕 an-eritāni vāditrabhāṇḍāni madhuraśabdān niścārayanti.
